title: Barriers to building a startup: why the cost of starting has never been lower
summary: Pieter Levels argues that the cost of starting a startup has collapsed. A cheap laptop, free tutorials, a $0.99 domain and a $2.49/mo server are enough to begin, so lack of resources is no longer a valid excuse.

principles.text: Starting a startup costs almost nothing now, so lack of money is not a valid excuse to wait.
principles.quote: The barriers of entry to building a startup have never been so low:

principles.text: Free learning resources like YouTube code tutorials remove the need for formal training before building.
Infrastructure is cheap: a domain and a VPS cost a few dollars, so you can launch and host on a tiny budget.
Stop waiting and start building; the tools and costs are no longer the obstacle.
